data.title: EXCLUSIVE: Tesla's Biggest Robotics Advantage Isn't AI, RoboStrategy CEO Says
data.description: When investors think about Tesla Inc‘s (NASDAQ:TSLA) humanoid robotics ambitions, the conversation usually begins with artificial intelligence. Andrew Kang, CEO of RoboStrategy, Inc. (NASDAQ:BOT), argues they’re looking in the wrong place. Tesla’s greatest long-term advantage is something far less glamorous, he says. “It is their manufacturing competency and resources,” Kang told Benzinga in an email.
